Physical flexibility envelope of a profile's responsive sessions

Source: R/smart-charging.R
get_flex_envelope.Rd

Shared by get_setpoints() and get_setpoints_v2g(), so the one-way and the V2G setpoints plan within the same physical limits:

Usage

get_flex_envelope(
  sessions,
  dttm_seq,
  profile,
  load_capacity = Inf,
  energy_min = 1,
  soc_min = NULL
)

Arguments

sessions

tibble, the responsive sessions of one profile in a window

dttm_seq

datetime vector of the window

profile

character, the profile name

load_capacity

numeric (vector), maximum flexible load in kW

energy_min

numeric, share of each session's energy owed at departure

soc_min

numeric or NULL, SoC floor of the V2G sessions (fraction)

Value

list with the numeric vectors LFmax, owed and reserve, each of length(dttm_seq)

Details

  • LFmax: the power the responsive sessions can draw at each slot, i.e. their nominal Power over their connection (the demand they would produce charging at nominal power for the whole connection), capped by load_capacity. Inf when no session is given.

  • owed: the cumulative energy owed to the sessions that have departed by the end of each slot, energy_min * Energy per session, in the units of the setpoint (kW per slot, i.e. kWh divided by the slot length in hours). A session is due in the slot containing its departure, or its uncontrolled charging end when that is later (a session that cannot charge its energy within its connection), so its uncontrolled profile always meets the deadline and the original profile stays feasible.

  • reserve (only with soc_min, else zeros): the energy the connected V2G sessions can still discharge at each slot, (StateOfCharge - soc_min) * BatteryCapacity per session, from its arrival slot up to the slot before the one it is due in, in the same units. It is negative for a session that arrives below the SoC floor, which has to charge up to the floor first. See smart_v2g() for BatteryCapacity.
